title: G-Shock Casual Men Watch GM-2110D-8ADR
description:
Check out the GM-2110D — the iconic analog-digital GA-2100, but with a stylish metal bezel and band update.

Meticulously forged, cut, and polished, the uniform octagonal metal bezel anchors the same tough construction in a simple, no-fuss design.

With the case made of high-rigidity glass-fiber-reinforced fine resin, glossy metallic dial — in breezily sophisticated blue-green or luxuriously chic slate gray — and the metal band, this timepiece is up for anything, work or play.
features: Other features: 12/24-hour format Hand shift feature (Hands move out of the way to provide an unobstructed view of digital display contents.) Regular timekeeping: Analog: 2 hands (hour, minute (hand moves every 20 seconds)), 1 dial (day) Digital: Hour, minute, second, pm, month, date
